events.summary: They crucified Him at the place called Calvary, and two others with Him. He said, It is finished, and gave up the ghost; and the veil of the temple was rent in twain.

events.title: The burial
events.summary: Joseph of Arimathaea craved the body and wrapped it in linen, and Nicodemus brought myrrh and aloes; they laid Him in a new tomb wherein was never man yet laid.

events.title: The resurrection
events.summary: He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord.

events.title: The road to Emmaus
events.summary: Beginning at Moses and all the prophets, He expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself; and they knew him in the breaking of bread.

events.title: My Lord and my God
events.summary: Reach hither thy finger, and be not faithless, but believing. Thomas answered, My Lord and my God; and Jesus blessed them that have not seen, and yet have believed.

events.title: The great commission
events.summary: Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost; and, lo, I am with you alway.

events.title: The ascension
events.summary: While they beheld, He was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight; and two men in white apparel said He should so come in like manner.

events.title: Matthias numbered with the eleven
events.summary: They prayed, Thou, Lord, which knowest the hearts of all men, shew whether of these two thou hast chosen; and the lot fell upon Matthias.

events.title: The day of Pentecost
events.summary: There came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and cloven tongues like as of fire sat upon each of them; that day about three thousand souls were added.

events.title: Silver and gold have I none
events.summary: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk; the man leaped and praised God, and Peter told the council there is none other name given whereby we must be saved.

events.title: Ananias and Sapphira
events.summary: They kept back part of the price and lied to the Holy Ghost; both fell down and gave up the ghost, and great fear came upon all the church.

events.title: Gamaliel's counsel
events.summary: If this work be of men, it will come to nought: but if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

events.title: Seven men of honest report chosen
events.summary: The apostles gave themselves to prayer and the ministry of the word, and set seven over the daily ministration, among them Stephen and Philip.

events.title: Stephen, the first martyr
events.summary: He saw the heavens opened and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God; as they stoned him he prayed, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge.

events.title: Philip and the man of Ethiopia
events.summary: Beginning at the same scripture in Isaiah, he preached unto him Jesus; and they went down into the water and he baptized him.

events.title: Saul struck down on the road to Damascus
events.summary: A light from heaven shined round about him, and a voice said, Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me? Ananias came, and he received sight and was baptized.

events.title: Tabitha, arise
events.summary: Peter put them all forth, kneeled down and prayed, and said, Tabitha, arise; she opened her eyes, and many believed in the Lord at Joppa.

events.title: The Gentiles receive the Holy Ghost
events.summary: While Peter yet spake the Holy Ghost fell on all them which heard the word, and the brethren said, Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life.

events.title: The disciples called Christians at Antioch
events.summary: Barnabas fetched Saul from Tarsus, and a whole year they taught much people; and the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

events.title: Peter delivered out of prison
events.summary: Prayer was made without ceasing for him; the angel smote him on the side, the chains fell off, and the iron gate opened to them of his own accord.

events.title: The first missionary journey
events.summary: The Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul. They sailed to Cyprus and went through Iconium and Lystra, confirming the souls of the disciples.

events.title: Paul stoned at Lystra
events.summary: They drew him out of the city supposing he had been dead; but he rose up and went again into the city, saying that through much tribulation we must enter the kingdom of God.

events.title: The council at Jerusalem
events.summary: Through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they. James gave sentence, and the burden of the law was not laid upon the Gentiles.

events.title: Titus travels with Paul
events.summary: Paul took Titus with him to Jerusalem, where Titus was a Greek and was not compelled to be circumcised; Paul later called him his partner and fellowhelper.

events.title: Come over into Macedonia, and help us
events.summary: A vision appeared to Paul in the night at Troas, and immediately they endeavoured to go, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called them to preach there.

events.title: Lydia, and the jailor at Philippi
events.summary: The Lord opened Lydia's heart; and at midnight, when Paul and Silas sang praises, the prison shook and the keeper asked, What must I do to be saved?

events.title: Thessalonica and Berea
events.summary: Three sabbath days he reasoned out of the scriptures; the Bereans were more noble, receiving the word with all readiness and searching the scriptures daily.

events.title: Paul's second letter to Thessalonica
events.summary: Paul, Silvanus and Timotheus addressed the church of the Thessalonians, teaching steadfastness in the coming of the Lord and signing the letter with Paul's own hand.

events.title: The Unknown God at Athens
events.summary: Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you. He told them God now commandeth all men every where to repent, and pointed to the day of judgment.

events.title: A year and six months at Corinth
events.summary: Be not afraid, but speak: for I have much people in this city. He continued teaching the word of God among them a year and six months.

events.title: Apollos taught the way more perfectly
events.summary: Aquila and Priscilla took him unto them and expounded the way of God more perfectly; and he mightily convinced the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

events.title: Two years at Ephesus
events.summary: All they which dwelt in Asia heard the word; the books of curious arts were burned, and the silversmiths raised an uproar crying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.

events.title: Eutychus taken up alive
events.summary: He fell from the third loft as Paul preached till midnight; Paul fell on him and embraced him, and said, Trouble not yourselves; for his life is in him.

events.title: Paul taken in the temple
events.summary: All the city was moved, and they drew him out of the temple; from the stairs he told them he was a Jew brought up at the feet of Gamaliel.

events.title: Before Felix, Festus and Agrippa
events.summary: Felix trembled as he reasoned of judgment to come; Paul appealed unto Caesar; and Agrippa said, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

events.title: Shipwreck on Melita
events.summary: They all escaped safe to land as the angel had promised; a viper fastened on Paul's hand and he shook it off into the fire and felt no harm.

events.title: Two whole years in his own hired house
events.summary: Paul dwelt at Rome with a soldier that kept him, preaching the kingdom of God and teaching those things which concern the Lord Jesus Christ, no man forbidding him.

events.title: Paul writes for Onesimus
events.summary: Paul appealed to Philemon for Onesimus, whom he called his son begotten in his bonds and a brother beloved, and sent greetings to the saints at Colosse.

events.title: I have finished my course
events.summary: Writing to Timothy from prison, Paul said he had fought a good fight and kept the faith, and that a crown of righteousness was laid up for him.

events.title: Luke writes to Theophilus
events.summary: Luke addressed the most excellent Theophilus, writing an orderly account of the things most surely believed among the saints and of all that Jesus began both to do and teach.

events.title: Jude urges believers to contend
events.summary: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, exhorted believers to contend for the faith once delivered unto the saints.

events.title: Three men named in 3 John
events.summary: The short letter of 3 John commends Gaius, rejects Diotrephes' preeminence and gives Demetrius a good report of all men and of the truth itself.

events.title: The Revelation given on Patmos
events.summary: John was in the isle called Patmos for the word of God, and in the Spirit on the Lord's day heard a great voice; the book ends, Surely I come quickly. Amen.

events.summary: Nadab and Abihu offered strange fire which He commanded them not, and there went out fire from the LORD and devoured them.

events.title: The day of atonement appointed
events.summary: Once a year the high priest went within the veil with blood, and the scapegoat bore away the iniquities of the people unto a land not inhabited.

events.title: The twelve spies, and Israel's refusal
events.summary: Ten brought an evil report; Caleb said, Let us go up at once and possess it. The people would not, and were turned back into the wilderness.

events.title: Forty years in the wilderness
events.summary: A year for each day the spies searched the land, until all that generation fell in the wilderness; their clothes waxed not old upon them.

events.title: Korah's rebellion
events.summary: Korah, Dathan and Abiram gathered against Moses and Aaron; the earth opened her mouth and swallowed them up, and they went down alive into the pit.

events.title: The brasen serpent
events.summary: Fiery serpents bit the people; Moses made a serpent of brass and set it on a pole, and every one that beheld it lived.

events.title: Phinehas turns away the plague
events.summary: When Israel joined itself to Baalpeor, Phinehas rose up and executed judgment, and the plague was stayed; he was given a covenant of an everlasting priesthood.

events.title: Moses dies on Mount Nebo
events.summary: The LORD shewed him all the land from the top of Pisgah, and he died there; his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated, and no man knows his grave.

events.title: The transfiguration
events.summary: His face did shine as the sun and his raiment was white as the light; Moses and Elias appeared with him, and a voice out of the cloud said, Hear ye him.

results.name: Aaron
results.description: Moses' brother and spokesman, the first high priest of Israel. He made the golden calf at the people's demand, and his rod budded before the LORD.

results.name: Abel
results.description: A keeper of sheep, whose more excellent sacrifice the LORD had respect unto. Slain by his brother, he being dead yet speaketh.

results.name: Abigail
results.description: A woman of good understanding and beautiful countenance, wife of Nabal, who met David with provisions and kept him from avenging himself with his own hand.

results.name: Abimelech
results.description: Son of Gideon, who slew his threescore and ten brethren upon one stone and made himself king in Shechem; a woman cast a millstone upon his head.

results.name: Abner
results.description: Captain of Saul's host who made Ishbosheth king, then turned to David and was slain by Joab in the gate of Hebron.

results.name: Abraham
results.description: Called out of Ur to a land God would show him, and given the covenant and the promise of a seed. He believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

results.name: Agrippa
results.description: The king who heard Paul's defence and answered, Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian.

results.name: Ananias
results.description: A disciple at Damascus, sent to lay hands on Saul that he might receive his sight; he called him brother Saul though he had feared him.

results.name: Apollos
results.description: A Jew of Alexandria, eloquent and mighty in the scriptures, fervent in the spirit, who mightily convinced the Jews that Jesus was Christ.

results.name: Aquila
results.description: A Jew of Pontus and a tentmaker like Paul, who with his wife took Apollos and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.

results.name: Barnabas
results.description: The son of consolation, who sold his land and laid the money at the apostles' feet, vouched for Saul, and went with him to the Gentiles.

results.name: Cornelius
results.description: A centurion of the Italian band, a devout man that feared God and prayed alway; the Holy Ghost fell on him and his house while Peter yet spake.

results.name: Demetrius
results.description: The man who had a good report of all men, and of the truth itself, with the elder's record also true.

results.name: Diotrephes
results.description: The man who loved to have the preeminence among the church and would not receive the elder or the brethren.

results.name: Dorcas
results.description: A disciple at Joppa full of good works and almsdeeds, who fell sick and died, and whom Peter raised, saying, Tabitha, arise.

results.name: Felix
results.description: The governor before whom Paul reasoned of righteousness, temperance and judgment to come, so that he trembled, yet left Paul bound.

results.name: Festus
results.description: Felix's successor, who said with a loud voice that much learning had made Paul mad, and before whom Paul appealed unto Caesar.

results.name: Gaius
results.description: The wellbeloved Gaius, whom the elder loved in the truth and commended for walking in the truth and receiving the brethren.

results.name: Gamaliel
results.description: A doctor of the law had in reputation among all the people, at whose feet Paul was brought up, and who counselled the council to let the apostles alone.

results.name: James the Lord's brother
results.description: Who gave the sentence at the council in Jerusalem, and whose epistle says, Be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only.

results.name: Jude
results.description: The servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, who wrote exhorting believers earnestly to contend for the faith once delivered unto the saints.

results.name: Luke
results.description: The beloved physician who stayed with Paul to the end, and who wrote an orderly account of all that Jesus began both to do and teach.

results.name: Lydia
results.description: A seller of purple of Thyatira, who worshipped God; the Lord opened her heart, and she constrained Paul's company to come into her house.

results.name: Mark
results.description: Who departed from Paul and Barnabas at Pamphylia and was the cause of their parting; Paul afterward called him profitable to him for the ministry.

results.name: Matthias
results.description: Numbered with the eleven apostles after the lot fell upon him, having companied with them all the time the Lord went in and out among them.

results.name: Onesimus
results.description: A servant who had departed from Philemon and was begotten in Paul's bonds; sent back no longer as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved.

results.name: Paul
results.description: A Pharisee who breathed out threatenings, struck down on the road to Damascus and made the apostle to the Gentiles; he finished his course keeping the faith.

results.name: Philemon
results.description: Paul's dearly beloved fellowlabourer, in whose house a church met, and to whom Paul wrote for Onesimus, offering to pay whatever he owed.

results.name: Philip the evangelist
results.description: One of the seven, who preached Christ in Samaria and was sent into the desert to the man of Ethiopia, opening the scripture at Isaiah's prophecy.

results.name: Priscilla
results.description: Aquila's wife and Paul's helper in Christ Jesus, who with her husband laid down her own neck for his life and taught Apollos more perfectly.

results.name: Sapphira
results.description: Wife of Ananias, who agreed with her husband to keep back part of the price of the land and to lie to the Holy Ghost.

results.name: Silas
results.description: Chosen by Paul after he parted from Barnabas; beaten and in the stocks at Philippi, he sang praises unto God at midnight.

results.name: Stephen
results.description: A man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, the first of the seven; he saw the heavens opened, and as they stoned him he prayed, Lay not this sin to their charge.

results.name: Theophilus
results.description: The most excellent Theophilus, to whom Luke wrote both his gospel and the Acts, that he might know the certainty of those things.

results.name: Timothy
results.description: A disciple of Lystra, son of a believing mother, whom Paul took with him and called his own son in the faith, charging him to preach the word.

results.name: Titus
results.description: A Greek and Paul's partner and fellowhelper, whose coming comforted him, and who was left in Crete to set in order the things that are wanting.

results.name: Ai
results.description: The city Israel could not take while Achan's sin was in the camp, and which was taken afterward by ambush.

results.name: Antioch
results.description: The church that first sent Barnabas and Saul out to the Gentiles, and where the disciples were called Christians first.

results.name: Ararat
results.description: The mountains where the ark rested in the seventh month, as the waters of the flood abated.

results.name: Ashdod
results.description: The Philistine city where the captured ark was set in the house of Dagon, and where Dagon fell before it.

results.name: Assyria
results.description: The empire the LORD used as the rod of His anger, which carried Israel away out of their own land and besieged Jerusalem in Hezekiah's day.

results.name: Athens
results.description: The city wholly given to idolatry where Paul's spirit was stirred in him, and where he preached the Unknown God on Mars' hill.

results.name: Babel
results.description: The city and tower built in the land of Shinar, whose builders meant to reach unto heaven. It is called Babel because there the LORD confounded the language of all the earth.

results.name: Babylon
results.description: The kingdom that burnt the temple and carried Judah captive for seventy years, and whose name Revelation gives to the great harlot city.

results.name: Beersheba
results.description: The well and place of oath in the south, named when Abraham and Abimelech sware there. "From Dan even to Beersheba" came to mean the whole land.

results.name: Berea
results.description: Whose hearers were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind and searched the scriptures daily.

results.name: Bethany
results.description: The town of Mary, Martha and Lazarus, where the Lord raised Lazarus and was anointed, and out as far as which He led the disciples before He was taken up.

results.name: Bethel
results.description: The place where Jacob dreamed of the ladder and called the name of it Bethel, saying, This is none other but the house of God. Jeroboam later set a golden calf there.

results.name: Bethlehem
results.description: The city of David, where Ruth gleaned, where Samuel anointed David, and where Micah said the Ruler in Israel should come forth; there Jesus Christ was born.

results.name: Bethsaida
results.description: The city of Andrew and Peter, where the Lord healed a blind man by leading him out of the town, and which He reproved for not repenting.

results.name: Caesarea
results.description: The coastal city where Cornelius sent for Peter and the Gentiles received the Holy Ghost, and where Paul was kept and heard by Felix, Festus and Agrippa.

results.name: Caesarea Philippi
results.description: The coasts where Jesus asked, Whom say ye that I am, and Peter answered, Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.

results.name: Cana
results.description: The village of Galilee where Jesus turned the water into wine, the beginning of miracles, and where He healed the nobleman's son by a word.

results.name: Canaan
results.description: The land the LORD promised to Abraham and to his seed for an everlasting possession, and which Israel came to possess under Joshua.

results.name: Capernaum
results.description: The city on the sea coast where Jesus dwelt after leaving Nazareth; He taught in its synagogue and did many mighty works there.

results.name: Colosse
results.description: The city of the saints and faithful brethren in Christ to whom Paul wrote of the preeminence of the Son.

results.name: Corinth
results.description: Where Paul stayed a year and six months teaching the word of God, having been told, I have much people in this city; he wrote it two epistles.

results.name: Crete
results.description: The island Paul's ship sailed under, and where he left Titus to set in order the things that were wanting and ordain elders in every city.

results.name: Cyprus
results.description: The island Barnabas came from and the first stop of the journey he and Saul were sent on from Antioch.

results.name: Damascus
results.description: The city Saul was journeying to with letters against the disciples when the light shined about him; there Ananias was sent to him and he first preached Christ.

results.name: Dan
results.description: The northernmost city of Israel, named by the Danites after they took Laish; Jeroboam set the second golden calf there.

results.name: Eden
results.description: The garden the LORD God planted eastward, where He put the man He had formed. Adam and Eve were driven out of it after they ate of the tree.

results.name: Edom
results.description: The land of Esau's descendants, south of the Dead Sea, which refused Israel passage in the wilderness and against which the prophets spoke.

results.name: Egypt
results.description: The land Abram went down to in famine, where Joseph rose to rule, where Israel was in bondage four hundred and thirty years, and out of which the LORD brought them with a mighty hand.

results.name: Elim
results.description: The camp beyond Marah where there were twelve wells of water and threescore and ten palm trees.

results.name: Emmaus
results.description: The village about threescore furlongs from Jerusalem toward which two disciples walked when the risen Lord joined them and opened the scriptures.

results.name: Endor
results.description: Where Saul, on the eve of his last battle, sought out a woman that had a familiar spirit.

results.name: Ephesus
results.description: Where Paul taught two years so that all Asia heard the word, where the silversmiths raised an uproar for Diana, and the first of the seven churches of Revelation.

results.name: Galatia
results.description: The region whose churches Paul wrote to when they were being turned to another gospel, and among whom he had first preached through infirmity of the flesh.

results.name: Gath
results.description: The Philistine city Goliath came out of, and to which David fled from Saul and feigned madness before Achish.

results.name: Gaza
results.description: The Philistine city where Samson carried away the gates and where he was bound and afterward pulled down the house of Dagon.

results.name: Gethsemane
results.description: The place where Jesus prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me, and where Judas betrayed Him.

results.name: Gibeah
results.description: The city of Saul, where he dwelt after he was made king, and the place of the outrage that brought all Israel against Benjamin.

results.name: Gilead
results.description: The hill country east of Jordan where Laban overtook Jacob, given to Reuben, Gad and half Manasseh, and famous for its balm.

results.name: Gilgal
results.description: Israel's first camp west of Jordan, where the twelve stones were set up, where they were circumcised and kept the passover, and where Saul was made king.

results.name: Golgotha
results.description: The place of a skull where they crucified the Lord Jesus, and two others with Him, on either side one.

results.name: Gomorrah
results.description: The city overthrown with Sodom when the LORD rained brimstone and fire out of heaven. Scripture holds both up ever after as a warning.

results.name: Goshen
results.description: The best of the land of Egypt, given to Jacob's house at Joseph's word; Israel dwelt there, and the plagues did not touch it.

results.name: Haran
results.description: The city where Terah settled and died, from which Abram departed at seventy and five years old, and to which Jacob fled from Esau.

results.name: Hazor
results.description: The head of the northern kingdoms, which Joshua took and burnt with fire; Jabin king of Hazor later oppressed Israel in the days of Deborah.

results.name: Hebron
results.description: Where Abram dwelt by the oaks of Mamre and buried Sarah, and where David reigned over Judah seven years and six months before he took Jerusalem.

results.name: Horeb
results.description: The mountain of God where the LORD appeared to Moses in the burning bush, and where Elijah afterward heard the still small voice.

results.name: Iconium
results.description: The city where Paul and Barnabas spake so that a great multitude believed, and out of which they were driven; Paul later reminded Timothy of his sufferings there.

results.name: Jabbok
results.description: The ford Jacob passed over the night he sent his household ahead and was left alone; it was afterward a border in the land.

results.name: Jericho
results.description: The walled city Israel first took in Canaan, whose walls fell down flat after they compassed it seven days; Rahab and her house were saved alive.

results.name: Jerusalem
results.description: The stronghold David took from the Jebusites and made the city of David; the place of Solomon's temple, of the Lord's crucifixion and resurrection, and of Pentecost.

results.name: Jezreel
results.description: Where Ahab had his palace and Naboth his vineyard, and where Jezebel was thrown down from the window.

results.name: Joppa
results.description: The sea port Jonah went down to in fleeing to Tarshish, where Peter raised Tabitha and saw the vision of the sheet let down from heaven.

results.name: Jordan
results.description: The river Israel crossed on dry ground into the promised land, where Naaman washed seven times, and where John baptized and the Lord Jesus was baptized.

results.name: Kadeshbarnea
results.description: The place in the wilderness from which the twelve spies were sent into Canaan, and where Israel refused to go up and was turned back.

results.name: Lystra
results.description: Where a man impotent in his feet was healed and the people would have done sacrifice to Paul and Barnabas, and where Paul was stoned; Timothy was from there.

results.name: Marah
results.description: The first water Israel found after the sea, and it was bitter; the LORD showed Moses a tree, and the waters were made sweet.

results.name: Melita
results.description: The island where Paul was cast ashore after the shipwreck, where a viper fastened on his hand and he shook it off into the fire unharmed.

results.name: Midian
results.description: The land Moses fled to from Pharaoh, where he married Zipporah and kept the flock of Jethro before the LORD called him.

results.name: Mizpah
results.description: The place of gathering: where Jacob and Laban heaped stones, where Israel assembled as one man, and where Samuel judged and Saul was chosen king.

results.name: Moab
results.description: The land east of Jordan where Israel camped before crossing over, where Balak hired Balaam, and from which Ruth came.

results.name: Moriah
results.description: The land whose mountain God named when He told Abraham to offer Isaac there; Solomon afterward built the house of the LORD in mount Moriah.

results.name: Mount Carmel
results.description: Where Elijah called all Israel together and the fire of the LORD fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice before the prophets of Baal.

results.name: Mount Ebal
results.description: The mount of cursing, where Joshua built an altar and wrote upon the stones a copy of the law of Moses.

results.name: Mount Gerizim
results.description: The mount of blessing over against Ebal, and where Jotham stood and cried his parable to the men of Shechem.

results.name: Mount Gilboa
results.description: Where the Philistines fought against Israel, and where Saul and his sons fell.

results.name: Mount Nebo
results.description: The mountain over against Jericho from whose top the LORD shewed Moses all the land, and where Moses died.

results.name: Mount of Olives
results.description: The mount east of Jerusalem from which the Lord rode into the city, where He taught of His coming, and from which He ascended.

results.name: Mount Sinai
results.description: The mount the LORD descended upon in fire, where He spake the ten commandments and gave Moses the two tables of testimony written with the finger of God.

results.name: Nazareth
results.description: The city of Galilee where Joseph and Mary dwelt and where Jesus was brought up; He read Isaiah in its synagogue and was cast out of the city.

results.name: Nineveh
results.description: The great city of Assyria that Jonah was sent to, which repented at his preaching; Nahum afterward pronounced its burden.

results.name: Patmos
results.description: The isle where John was for the word of God and for the testimony of Jesus Christ, and where he was in the Spirit on the Lord's day.

results.name: Peniel
results.description: The place Jacob named after wrestling until the breaking of the day, saying, I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.

results.name: Philippi
results.description: The chief city of that part of Macedonia, where Lydia's heart was opened, where Paul and Silas sang at midnight in the prison, and to which Paul wrote an epistle.

results.name: Ramah
results.description: Samuel's city, where he judged Israel, anointed kings and was buried; Jeremiah heard a voice of weeping there.

results.name: Red Sea
results.description: The sea the LORD divided so Israel went through on dry ground, and in which Pharaoh's host was drowned.

results.name: Rephidim
results.description: The camp where there was no water and the LORD gave it out of the rock in Horeb, and where Amalek came and fought with Israel.

results.name: Rome
results.description: The imperial city Paul was brought to as a prisoner, where he dwelt two whole years preaching the kingdom of God, and to which he wrote his great epistle.

results.name: Samaria
results.description: The hill Omri bought and built on, the capital of the ten tribes until Assyria carried them away; in the Gospels and Acts, the region between Judaea and Galilee.

results.name: Sea of Galilee
results.description: The sea where Jesus called fishermen to follow Him, stilled the storm, walked on the water, and appeared to the disciples after He was risen.

results.name: Shechem
results.description: The first place in Canaan where Abram pitched, where Jacob later bought a parcel of a field, and where Joshua gathered the tribes and made a covenant.

results.name: Shiloh
results.description: Where the tabernacle of the congregation was set up and the land divided by lot, and where Samuel ministered before Eli.

results.name: Shushan
results.description: The palace of the Persian kings where Esther was made queen, where Nehemiah served the king, and where Daniel saw a vision.

results.name: Sidon
results.description: The coastal city near Tyre; Zarephath belonged to it, and the Lord went into its borders and healed the daughter of a Syrophenician woman.

results.name: Sodom
results.description: The city of the plain toward which Lot pitched his tent, whose men were wicked and sinners before the LORD exceedingly, and which the LORD overthrew with brimstone and fire.

results.name: Sychar
results.description: The city of Samaria near Jacob's well, where Jesus spoke to the woman of Samaria and many of the Samaritans believed.

results.name: Tarsus
results.description: Paul's own city in Cilicia; he called it no mean city, and the brethren sent him there for safety after his conversion.

results.name: Thessalonica
results.description: Where Paul reasoned three sabbath days out of the scriptures and a church was gathered, to which he wrote two epistles.

results.name: Troas
results.description: Where Paul saw the vision of a man of Macedonia praying him to come over and help them, and where Eutychus fell from the third loft and was taken up alive.

results.name: Tyre
results.description: The city of Hiram, who sent David and Solomon cedar and workmen; the prophets afterward spoke against her pride, and the Lord named her in reproving Chorazin.

results.name: Ur
results.description: The city of the Chaldees that Terah left with Abram, and out of which the LORD brought Abram.

results.name: Valley of Elah
results.description: Where Israel and the Philistines set the battle in array and David slew Goliath with a sling and a stone.

results.name: Zarephath
results.description: The city of Zidon where Elijah was sustained by a widow whose barrel of meal did not waste, and whose son was raised to life.

results.name: Zion
results.description: The stronghold David took, called the city of David; Scripture uses the name for the mountain of the LORD's house and for His people.

results.name: Saul
results.description: The first king of Israel, higher than any of the people from his shoulders upward. He was rejected for disobedience, hunted David, and fell on his own sword at Gilboa.

results.name: Paul
results.description: A Pharisee who breathed out threatenings, struck down on the road to Damascus and made the apostle to the Gentiles; he finished his course keeping the faith.

results.name: Joseph
results.description: Jacob's beloved son, sold into Egypt by his brethren, imprisoned falsely, and raised to rule all the land. He told them, Ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.

results.name: Joseph
results.description: A just man of the house of David, espoused to Mary, who took her to wife at the angel's word and carried the young child into Egypt.

results.name: The flood
results.description: All the fountains of the great deep were broken up, and every living substance was destroyed. Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.

results.name: The burial
results.description: Joseph of Arimathaea craved the body and wrapped it in linen, and Nicodemus brought myrrh and aloes; they laid Him in a new tomb wherein was never man yet laid.

events.title: The walls of Jericho fall
events.summary: They compassed the city once a day for six days and seven times on the seventh; the people shouted, and the wall fell down flat.

events.title: Jude urges believers to contend
events.summary: Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ and brother of James, exhorted believers to contend for the faith once delivered unto the saints.
